parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query.

parameters.name: EngineType
parameters.description:
The database engine type. Valid values:
- **MySQL**
- **MariaDB**
- **Oracle**
- **PostgreSQL**
- **SQLServer**

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset instance to which the column data in the data asset table belongs.

> Queries column data in data asset tables authorized for connection by Data Security Center based on the asset instance ID. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~DescribeRules~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the asset instance to which the column data in the data asset table belongs.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese.
- **en_us**: English.

parameters.name: ModelTagId
parameters.description:
The data tag.

- 101: personal sensitive information

- 102: personal information

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The keyword to search for. Fuzzy match is supported.

For example, if you enter **test**, all data entries that contain **test** in the search fields are returned.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The name of the product to which the column data in the data asset table belongs. Valid values: **MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, RDS**, and others.

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description:
The ID that corresponds to the product name to which the data object belongs. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute
- **2**: OSS
- **3**: ADB-MYSQL
- **4**: TableStore
- **5**: RDS
- **6**: SELF_DB
- **7**: PolarDB-X
- **8**: PolarDB
- **9**: ADB-PG
- **10**: OceanBase
- **11**: MongoDB
- **25**: Redis

parameters.name: RiskLevelId
parameters.description:
The risk level ID of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: N/A.
- **2**: S1.
- **3**: S2.
- **4**: S3.
- **5**: S4.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The unique ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches.

> Queries column data in data asset tables authorized for connection by Data Security Center based on the ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches. You can call the [DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~) operation to obtain the rule ID.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data in the data asset table matches.

parameters.name: SensLevelName
parameters.description:
The sensitivity level name. Valid values:
- **N/A**: No sensitive data is detected.
- **S1**: Level-1 sensitive data.
- **S2**: Level-2 sensitive data.
- **S3**: Level-3 sensitive data.
- **S4**: Level-4 sensitive data.

parameters.name: TableId
parameters.description:
The unique ID of the data asset table to which the columns belong in MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, or other assets.

> Queries column data in data asset tables authorized for connection by Data Security Center based on the table ID. You can call the [DescribeTables](~~DescribeTables~~) operation to obtain the table ID.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the data asset table.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The industry template ID.
> You can call the [DescribeCategoryTemplateList](~~2399296~~) operation to obtain the industry template ID.

parameters.name: TemplateRuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the matched template rule.
> You can call the [DescribeCategoryTemplateRuleList](~~410143~~) operation to obtain the matched template rule ID.
